title: Committed observation store registry
description: config/stores.yaml -- the single declaration of every committed observation store (PR1 of the pipeline repair). See src/stores.py for the loader, and docs/decisions/0002-split-committed-stores.md and docs/decisions/0006-stores-split-by-volume.md for why stores are split as they are.

path.description: Repo-relative path. For layout: single_csv (the default), the committed CSV itself, in the canonical 10-column observations shape. For layout: one_csv_per_indicator, the directory holding one such CSV per declared indicator (data/international/{INDICATOR_ID}.csv, never *_observations.csv).

layout.description: single_csv: one committed CSV holds every declared indicator's rows (every store before the international pilot). one_csv_per_indicator: `path` is a directory, and each declared indicator has its own {path}/{indicator_id}.csv -- a registry entry per file does not scale to ~100 international indicators. A declared indicator with zero rows in an in_db store of this layout has no file at all (a header-only CSV would make the next assemble load nothing and look identical to 'not fetched yet', which is not the distinction it needs to make).

source_id.description: The sources.source_id these observations are attributed to -- must match a config/sources/*.yaml source_id.

mode.description: in_db: loaded INTO the working database and dumped back out. extra_csv: passed to the exporters as --extra-observations and never loaded into the working database. A store may be in exactly one mode -- being in both would double-count it, since export_communes_history_csv.py takes every is_latest row from the DB AND every row from the CSV with no dedup.

indicators.description: Every distinct indicator_id actually present in this store's CSV, checked against the file's real contents. For an in_db store this is also the offload's row set (scripts/offload_stores.py), so it must name every indicator its sync writes -- including one configured but not fetched yet, the one case tolerated as absent from the CSV.

reference_rows.description: How to (re)create this store's sources/indicators rows from config, with no network. null is only valid together with reference_rows_reason.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the script, e.g. scripts/sync_fiscal_income.py

reference_rows_reason.description: Required (non-null) when reference_rows is null -- why no script exists yet.

history_shard.description: true: this store's indicators are written to their own data/communes_history/{name}.csv by scripts/export_communes_history_csv.py, instead of into the single committed data/communes_history.csv. Added when the core file grew past CLAUDE.md rule 12's 25 MB commit ceiling (PR: split-communes-history). Every indicator NOT claimed by a history_shard store -- including every derived indicator -- stays in the core file.
